points.title: 革命启蒙
points.description: 1833年，加里波第加入秘密革命组织青年意大利，结识了马志尼。1834年，他参与策划热那亚起义，反对撒丁王国统治。起义失败后，加里波第被迫流亡南美。这段经历塑造了他作为革命者的坚定信念，并开始形成他的军事战术思想，强调游击战和民众支持的重要性。热那亚的失败虽然短暂，却成为他革命生涯的起点，也让他认识到意大利统一的必要性和艰巨性。
points.descriptionEn: In 1833, Garibaldi joined the secret revolutionary society Young Italy and met Giuseppe Mazzini. In 1834, he participated in planning an uprising in Genoa against the rule of the Kingdom of Sardinia. After the failed uprising, Garibaldi was forced into exile in South America. This experience shaped him as a determined revolutionary and began to form his military tactical thinking, emphasizing guerrilla warfare and popular support. Although the Genoa failure was brief, it marked the beginning of his revolutionary career and made him realize the necessity and difficulty of Italian unification.

points.title: 流亡战士
points.description: 流亡南美期间，加里波第参与了巴西、乌拉圭和秘鲁的多场独立战争。他在乌拉圭建立了著名的意大利军团，并在保卫蒙得维的亚的战斗中展现出卓越的军事才能。1843年，他指挥的意大利军团在圣萨尔瓦多战役中击败了阿根廷军队，成为传奇。这段经历使加里波第从一名革命者成长为经验丰富的军事指挥官，他的战术思想和领导风格在此期间成熟，并赢得了'南美洲的英雄'称号。这些军事经验为他日后领导意大利统一战争奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: During his exile in South America, Garibaldi participated in several independence wars in Brazil, Uruguay, and Peru. He established the famous Italian Legion in Uruguay and demonstrated outstanding military talent in defending Montevideo. In 1843, his Italian Legion defeated the Argentine army in the Battle of San Salvador, becoming legendary. This period transformed Garibaldi from a revolutionary into an experienced military commander. His tactical thinking and leadership style matured during this time, earning him the title 'Hero of South America.' These military experiences laid a solid foundation for his later leadership in the Italian unification wars.

points.title: 罗马共和国
points.description: 1848年欧洲革命爆发后，加里波第返回意大利，投身于意大利统一运动。1849年，他率领志愿军保卫刚刚成立的罗马共和国，对抗法国、西班牙和那不勒斯王国的联合军队。尽管最终失败，加里波第的英勇抵抗为罗马共和国争取了宝贵时间。在罗马期间，他与马志尼合作，试图建立一个统一的意大利共和国。罗马的失败使加里波第认识到，意大利统一需要更复杂的政治策略和军事准备，不能仅依靠革命热情。这段经历也让他与撒丁王国国王维克多·伊曼纽尔二世的关系开始复杂化。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of the 1848 European revolutions, Garibaldi returned to Italy and dedicated himself to the Italian unification movement. In 1849, he led volunteer forces to defend the newly established Roman Republic against the combined armies of France, Spain, and the Kingdom of Naples. Despite the eventual failure, Garibaldi's heroic resistance bought precious time for the Roman Republic. During his time in Rome, he collaborated with Mazzini, attempting to establish a unified Italian republic. The failure in Rome made Garibaldi realize that Italian unification required more complex political strategies and military preparations, not just revolutionary enthusiasm. This experience also complicated his relationship with King Victor Emmanuel II of Sardinia.

points.title: 千人远征
points.description: 1859年，加里波第与撒丁王国合作，共同对抗奥地利。1860年5月，他率领约1000名志愿者（'红衫军'）从热那亚出发，开始了著名的'千人远征'。在西西里岛，加里波第迅速取得了一系列胜利，解放了整个岛屿。他的军队纪律严明，尊重当地居民，赢得了西西里人民的支持。1860年7月，他进入那不勒斯，迫使两西西里国王退位。这次远征是意大利统一进程中的关键一步，展示了加里波第作为军事领袖的非凡才能，也标志着意大利统一运动从革命理想主义向现实政治的转变。加里波第的成功促使维克多·伊曼纽尔二世成为意大利国王，加速了意大利统一的进程。
points.descriptionEn: In 1859, Garibaldi cooperated with the Kingdom of Sardinia against Austria. In May 1860, he led about 1,000 volunteers (the 'Redshirts') on his famous 'Expedition of the Thousand' from Genoa. In Sicily, Garibaldi quickly achieved a series of victories, liberating the entire island. His army was disciplined and respected local residents, winning the support of the Sicilian people. In July 1860, he entered Naples, forcing the King of the Two Sicilies to abdicate. This expedition was a crucial step in the Italian unification process, demonstrating Garibaldi's extraordinary talent as a military leader and marking the transformation of the Italian unification movement from revolutionary idealism to realpolitik. Garibaldi's success led to Victor Emmanuel II becoming King of Italy, accelerating the process of Italian unification.

points.title: 统一余晖
points.description: 1862年，加里波第试图夺取罗马，但被意大利军队阻止，本人受伤。1867年，他再次尝试占领罗马，但再次失败。尽管如此，加里波第的声望依然崇高，被视为意大利统一的象征。1870-1871年，普法战争期间，法国军队撤出罗马，意大利军队趁机占领罗马，完成了意大利统一。加里波第虽未直接参与这一行动，但他对统一的贡献得到了广泛认可。晚年，他隐居在卡普雷拉岛，继续支持意大利统一事业，同时撰写回忆录。加里波第的一生体现了理想主义与现实政治的复杂交织，他的军事才能和革命热情为意大利统一做出了不可磨灭的贡献，但也反映了19世纪民族主义运动的复杂性和局限性。
points.descriptionEn: In 1862, Garibaldi attempted to capture Rome but was stopped by Italian troops and was wounded himself. In 1867, he tried again to occupy Rome but failed once more. Despite these setbacks, Garibaldi's prestige remained high, and he was seen as a symbol of Italian unification. During the 1870-1871 Franco-Prussian War, French troops withdrew from Rome, and the Italian army took the opportunity to occupy Rome, completing Italian unification. Although Garibaldi did not directly participate in this action, his contribution to unification was widely recognized. In his later years, he lived in seclusion on Caprera Island, continuing to support the Italian unification cause while writing his memoirs. Garibaldi's life reflects the complex interplay between idealism and realpolitik. His military talent and revolutionary enthusiasm made an indelible contribution to Italian unification, but also reflect the complexities and limitations of 19th-century nationalist movements.

supporter.zh: 加里波第被意大利人民尊为'祖国的父亲'和'意大利统一的英雄'。支持者认为他是一位理想主义的革命家，凭借非凡的军事才能和无私的奉献精神，为意大利的统一奠定了基础。他的'千人远征'被视为民族解放的典范，展现了小股力量如何通过勇气和策略战胜强大敌人。加里波第的平等理念和民主思想，以及对普通民众的尊重，使他成为意大利民族精神的象征。他的遗产不仅体现在政治统一上，更在于激励后人追求自由与正义的理想。
supporter.en: Garibaldi is revered by the Italian people as the 'Father of the Fatherland' and 'Hero of Italian Unification.' Supporters view him as an idealistic revolutionary who, through extraordinary military talent and selfless dedication, laid the foundation for Italy's unification. His 'Expedition of the Thousand' is seen as a model of national liberation, demonstrating how a small force can defeat a powerful enemy through courage and strategy. Garibaldi's egalitarian ideals, democratic thoughts, and respect for ordinary people make him a symbol of the Italian national spirit. His legacy is not only reflected in political unification but also in inspiring future generations to pursue ideals of freedom and justice.

critic.zh: 批评者指出加里波第的军事行动往往缺乏长远政治规划，过度依赖个人魅力和军事才能。他的'千人远征'虽然成功，但也导致了政治上的混乱，使意大利统一进程更加复杂。此外，加里波第与马志尼等共和派人士的合作有限，最终接受了君主制，这被一些共和主义者视为背叛。批评者还认为，加里波第对民族主义的强调有时忽视了意大利内部的地方差异和多元文化，为后来的意大利政治问题埋下隐患。他的个人英雄主义色彩也掩盖了统一运动中集体努力的重要性。
critic.en: Critics point out that Garibaldi's military actions often lacked long-term political planning, relying excessively on personal charisma and military talent. While his 'Expedition of the Thousand' was successful, it also led to political complications, making the Italian unification process more complex. Additionally, Garibaldi's cooperation with republicans like Mazzini was limited, and his eventual acceptance of monarchy was seen by some republicans as a betrayal. Critics also argue that Garibaldi's emphasis on nationalism sometimes overlooked Italy's internal regional differences and multicultural diversity, sowing the seeds for later Italian political problems. His personal heroism also overshadowed the importance of collective efforts in the unification movement.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，加里波第被视为19世纪欧洲民族主义运动中最具魅力的领袖之一。历史学家承认他的军事才能和革命热情对意大利统一的决定性贡献，同时也分析他政治策略的局限性。流行文化中，加里波第的形象常常被浪漫化，成为自由与反抗的象征。他的红衫形象在全球范围内被模仿，影响了后来的革命运动。现代学者倾向于将加里波第置于更广阔的19世纪欧洲历史背景下，分析他与马志尼、维克多·伊曼纽尔二世等人的复杂互动，以及意大利统一运动在欧洲民族国家形成过程中的特殊地位。他的生平被视为理想主义与现实政治、个人英雄主义与集体运动之间复杂关系的典型案例。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Garibaldi is regarded as one of the most charismatic leaders of 19th-century European nationalist movements. Historians acknowledge his decisive contribution to Italian unification through military talent and revolutionary enthusiasm while also analyzing the limitations of his political strategies. In popular culture, Garibaldi's image is often romanticized, becoming a symbol of freedom and resistance. His red-shirted image has been imitated worldwide, influencing later revolutionary movements. Modern scholars tend to place Garibaldi in the broader context of 19th-century European history, analyzing his complex interactions with figures like Mazzini and Victor Emmanuel II, as well as the special position of the Italian unification movement in the formation of European nation-states. His life is seen as a typical case study of the complex relationship between idealism and realpolitik, and between individual heroism and collective movements.

self.zh: 我宁愿做一个自由的乞丐，也不愿做奴隶的国王。
self.en: I would rather be an exiled beggar than a king in slavery.

others.zh: 加里波第是历史上最伟大的战士之一，他的名字与自由和独立紧密相连。
others.en: Garibaldi was one of the greatest warriors in history, his name being inseparably linked with freedom and independence.
